title: Dry-processed thick electrode design with a porous conductive agent enabling 20 mA h cm−2 for high-energy-density lithium-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,645-658
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04106B, Paper
Hyeseong Oh, Gyu-Sang Kim, Jiyoon Bang, San Kim, Kyeong-Min Jeong
Dry-processed thick cathodes designed with a porous spherical conductive agent exhibit superior electrochemical performances, even with high areal capacities of up to 20 mA h cm−2 and a high composite density of 3.65 g cm−3.
